rounds.q: How many books did the average US adult read in 2025?
rounds.why: That average is pulled up by big readers. The typical adult read just 2, and 40% read none.
rounds.src: YouGov, Most Americans didn't read many books in 2025 (Dec 2025 survey)
rounds.fun: The average was 8 books, but the typical adult read just 2!

rounds.q: On an average day, how many minutes do Americans (15+) read for fun?
rounds.why: People 65 and older read the most, about 32 minutes a day.
rounds.src: BLS, American Time Use Survey (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Sixteen minutes a day, and readers 65 and up double it to about 32!

rounds.q: How many words a minute does the average adult read silently in English?
rounds.why: That's for nonfiction in English, from 190 studies. Fiction goes faster, at 260 words a minute.
rounds.src: Brysbaert, Journal of Memory and Language (2019 review of 190 studies)
rounds.fun: 238 words a minute for facts, 260 for stories. Novels really do fly by!

rounds.q: How many public library locations does the US have?
rounds.why: That's the 2024 count for the 50 states and DC, run by 9,200 library systems. Bookmobiles count too.
rounds.src: IMLS, Public Libraries Survey FY 2024 Data File Documentation and User's Guide
rounds.fun: 17,415 spots to borrow a book, and some of them have wheels!

rounds.q: How many printed books did the main US sales tracker count in 2025?
rounds.why: Circana BookScan counted 762.4 million at stores that report to it. The top title sold 2.8 million.
rounds.src: Circana BookScan via Publishers Weekly (2025 data)
rounds.fun: 762 million books in one year. That is one very tall reading pile!
